source: Issue #165 (D4). The declared authorization check ships its stated limits in the repository and a test pins this list exactly. A limit that is removed from the check must be removed here in the same reviewed diff.

entries.summary: SDK calls inside Lambda and Service runtime code, and CDK custom resources, are outside the call-site scan.
entries.consequence: The resource-type table covers the reads a synthesized template type implies; everything else is covered only by the observed layer.

entries.summary: Resource-less actions need an explicit reviewed wildcard marker; their resource cannot narrow.
entries.consequence: ecs:ListTasks, ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition, logs:DescribeLogGroups (list form) and the ELBv2 Describe* set are pinned in REVIEWED_WILDCARDS with a reason. A `*` grant without a marker fails.

entries.summary: The CDK bootstrap cfn-exec role holds AdministratorAccess and no permissions boundary; it is a stated exception, not an asserted principal.
entries.consequence: Effective permission on the Infra deploy path is account-wide. Only the Service deploy role, the Service CloudFormation role and the Infra runtime role are asserted; the administrator principal is recorded, never claimed as reviewed.

entries.summary: A Condition can be asserted present, never satisfied at runtime.
entries.consequence: The pre-mutation canary owns whether the condition lets the call through; the declared check only proves the condition exists.

entries.summary: The Service release chain's own call sites live in AnyWear-Service and are outside this repository's scan.
entries.consequence: The Service deploy role's required reads here are the Service-sourced bake fixture; its residual grants are checked by the reviewed-set direction, not by a derived call-site set.

entries.summary: The canary samples the resource set as it exists before mutation, so create-path authorization is outside its reach.
entries.consequence: The declared assertion and the post-run observation own create-path authorization.

entries.summary: cloudfront:GetDistribution is a conditional legacy fallback whose base grant the runtime role may deny by design; the session policy never adds grants.
entries.consequence: It is excluded from the canary probes and from the runtime role's required set; the fallback must surface through the observed layer if it is ever taken.

entries.summary: CloudTrail cannot see calls that never happened, and the audit only covers the four reconciled role sessions.
entries.consequence: Declared-but-unused is report-only with a minimum window and a recorded retention reason; it is narrowing input, not a narrowing decision.
